name: Vellum
avoid_for: Contexts that need visual heat or pop — the navy + warm-yellow Cormorant aesthetic is intentionally low-tempo
weak_cases: Dense or long content crowds structural empty space; dusty annotation colors need legibility checks.
visual_signature: Periwinkle field, yellow italic serif and small typewriter pin-note; intentionally still.

provenance.adaptation: Recipe retained and curated for Deck Studio; selector describes source-supported structures, not rendered acceptance.

language_posture: Italic serif personality and typewriter labels need script-aware alternatives; a substitute is a new visual interpretation.

assets.images: No image required; type, shapes and surface treatments can carry the system.
